title: TAI owner preflight workflow identity
objective: Give the owner-authorized six-job REG.RU preflight a unique workflow identity and bind restricted Qwen activation exclusively to that exact successful workflow, eliminating collisions with the legacy canonical-image preflight workflow ID.
boundaries: Owner preflight retains exact issue 3365 and exact command authority
Activation accepts only a successful exact-main run of TAI Owner REG.RU Preflight
All six required preflight jobs remain mandatory and fail-closed
Legacy preflight failures and skipped runs can no longer trigger production activation
No activation, deployment or model runtime logic is weakened
